checks.name: A new authored source is usable without being disguised as a default document revision
Free prose can be imported as an incomplete note without invented test criteria or approval
A source-backed complete contract still requires explicit review
Missing limits and source review remain explicit unknowns
Low-friction operating scope cannot be approved by schema validity
Independent and shared power failures produce different actual property outcomes
A stuck command is exposed by release pressure, not a preset label
Recovery uses declared tolerance and sustained window, and no fault is not a pass
Insufficient recovery observation is UNQUALIFIED, never silently PASS
Revision impact retains the previous failing result and snapshots
Only explicit structured unit equivalence is reused; changed free prose remains UNKNOWN
Unrelated source edits and mass preserve tracking validity; dependent dynamics do not
Question relevance, source scope and exact spans are preserved without an LLM
A model configuration mismatch or tampered numerical observable cannot create a reviewed result
Recomputed content checksums cannot legitimize a forged but bounded numerical trace
A source cannot omit an influential dependency to preserve an outdated result
Incomplete recovery clauses do not borrow an implicit tracking tolerance
Invalid units, instruction-like sources and direct record mutation cannot waive gates
Valid export/import preserves graph and results; malformed or forged result imports are refused
Controlled change-policy comparison executes real reruns and preserves safe baseline controls
